description: The approval runner as a Power Platform solution: two solution-aware cloud flows that pull approval requests from the product's API, send one Power Automate approval card per request, and post each answer back. build-solution.mjs turns this manifest and the two workflow files into an unpacked solution for one publisher prefix. {{prefix}} stands for that prefix and {{childFlowId}} for the ID the script gives the child flow.
solutionDescription: Sends the product's approval cards through Power Automate approvals and posts each answer to the product's approval outcome endpoint. It never approves anything itself.

environmentVariables.description: The product's public base URL, such as https://governance.contoso.com, with no trailing slash. Every HTTP action calls this host only.
The audience of the token the runner asks for: the Application ID URI of the product's API app registration.
The client's Microsoft Entra tenant ID.
The client ID of the runner's app registration, which holds the Approval.Write app role on the product's API.

The runner's certificate as base64 PFX content, kept as a secret in Azure Key Vault. The flows read it at run time with the Dataverse action RetrieveEnvironmentVariableSecretValue, with secure inputs and outputs.
The password of the PFX content, kept as a secret in Azure Key Vault. The HTTP action needs it with the certificate credential type.

workflows.description: Every five minutes, claims waiting approval requests from the product's API and starts the child flow once for each.

workflows.displayName: Approval runner: send card and wait
workflows.description: Sends one approval card for one claimed request, reports it as sent, waits for the first answer and posts it to the approval outcome endpoint.
